entities.summary: Michael Steven Duursma is a Dutch baseball coach for the Netherlands national team in the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC}. He is former professional shortstop who has played for Pioniers and the Dutch national team. He played in the 2008 Summer Olympics and 2006, 2009, and 2013 WBCs.
